channel_intelligence.suno_rules: Data-backed prompt rules, updated 2026-10-19: (1) ALWAYS 'instrumental / no vocals'. (2) KEEP ENERGY CONSISTENT, no dynamic spikes. (3) NAME THE INSTRUMENT: 'smooth jazz guitar' / 'piano trio' literally in prompt and title. (4) PIANO TRIO > SOFT BOSSA on current evidence (long +10.3 vs +0.3 views/video, Oct 15-17; shorts 2.3 vs 1.25). (5) SEASON THE TITLE AND PROMPT TOGETHER (cozy autumn / late night / rainy). (6) VARY RUNTIME 75-120 min on longs. (7) NAME THE ACTION (work session, coffee, morning, focus). (8) Thumbnail font/style effect still unmeasurable - fonts not tagged per video in adm-upload-state.json. (9) Evidence is thin (days of data, tiny counts); treat as direction, not proof.
